about: What each item name in the receipt corpus (scripts/fixtures/receipt-emails, all made up) really is, written by hand in round 5 (19 Nov 2026) for the names not already in uk-receipt-lines.json, with the same conventions. Scored before the rules were changed: 649 of 737 right (88.1%), with 28 never-wrong mistakes (Potato Wedges as footwear, Le Creuset casseroles as food, Wickes Bonding Coat as clothing, Sweet and Sour Chicken Hong Kong Style as a pet thing). scripts/test-item-kinds-corpus.mjs reads each email with Relay's own reader and classifies its items with that email's shop, as the app does.
